description_en: Queries the detection results of API security compliance requirements
description_zh: 查询API安全合规要求检测结果
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-detection-result --instance-id waf-cn-7pp26f10000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveDetectionResult

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

DetectionResult.description_en:
The compliance detection result. Valid values: 
report: A data cross-border transfer risk exists.
none: No data cross-border transfer risk exists
DetectionResult.description_zh:
合规检测结果。取值： 
report：表示存在数据出境风险。
none：表示不存在数据出境风险

List.description_en: The detection list of sensitive data types
List.description_zh: 敏感类型信息检测列表

items.description_en: The detection information of a sensitive data type
items.description_zh: 敏感类型数据检测信息

InfoCount.description_en: The number of personal information records

OutboundCount.description_en: The number of cross-border personal information records

Max.description_en: The maximum values of sensitive data type statistics
Max.description_zh: 敏感类型数据统计的最大值

InfoCount.description_en: The number of personal information records corresponding to the sensitive data type with the highest count
InfoCount.description_zh: 最多的敏感数据类型对应的个人信息数量

OutboundCount.description_en: The number of cross-border personal information records corresponding to the sensitive data type with the highest count
OutboundCount.description_zh: 最多的敏感数据类型对应的个人出境信息数量

SensitiveCode.description_en: The sensitive data type with the highest count
